CustomField.description: Age in days of the OLDEST unpaid item, per FSD 5.9.4. Not the average and not the newest - the oldest, because that is what escalation is measured against.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Age of the oldest unpaid item, in days. Yardi-sourced and overwritten on every nightly sync. Never edit this value in Salesforce - it will be replaced.
CustomField.label: Days Past Due
